description:
Singleton integration/closeout task after every module and decision task. Own final shared navigation/index updates, completed-scope manifest rollup and strict whole-scope CI activation; no authority to redo module files without handoff. Target: zero discretionary explanatory comments and authored explanatory docstrings in maintained first-party code. Only proven minimum machine directives and unavoidable provenance-bound required notices remain. Useful product strings must have an actual consumer; no inert constants, unused strings, fake metadata or dynamic __doc__ replacements. Never broaden lint/type/coverage ignores, weaken assertions, or turn unknown ownership/parser coverage into an exclusion.

Reconcile live merged source and exact heads for every manifest, not tracker 'done' labels. Rescan all declared code/config/payload/generator/consumer surfaces, including newly added paths. Unknown ownership/parser classes and unresolved actual docstring/prose consumers fail. Check generator reintroduction, actual help/discovery/API contract content and active symbol/section navigation. Preserve historical evidence and output bundles. Review all remaining exact machine directives/notices against current consumers/requirements and obsolete triggers; semantic checker limits remain explicit.

Record accepted/rejected/no-change dispositions of mechanism/algorithm/policy candidates and all external plan-review findings. An unresolved approved required cleanup does not disappear into an appendix or exclusion. Report local checks, exact-head hosted CI, independent review, merges and any operator-controlled acceptance separately. Execution guard: creation of this TODO is planning, not approval to execute the reviewed cleanup. Obtain later implementation authorization. Use a separate linked worktree and agent-write-preflight; preserve unrelated work. Freeze nonoverlapping code/test/doc paths with the integrator before dispatch. Ordinary independent PRs target develop; serialize shared test-lock checks and integration, not module edits. Required native/external soundness review remains mandatory, with no auto-merge bypass. No live cloud/stress, deployment, publication, historical-result rewriting, or unapproved external-repository writes.
